ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio dominated by high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 90% of the visible surface, framed by a low-intensity (black) boundary along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous high-intensity white zone across both lobes. Secondary low-intensity black border along the trailing edge. Several discrete, low-intensity circular focal spots are mapped: one in the mid-left lobe, one adjacent to the median notch on the right lobe, and several smaller spots scattered near the lower visible margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 70-80 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) visible continuously along the dark trailing edge boundary from the median notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge, sweeping upwards and outwards to form pointed, dorsally-oriented tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct dark circular pixel clusters (focal spots) on the white ventral surface. Highly localized, textured brown/tan clusters (barnacle colonization) are visible at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacle clusters) present on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, creating an irregular, high-contrast texture compared to the smooth fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The lower portion of the fluke lobes is obscured by high-intensity white pixel noise caused by water turbulence/spray.
